== Summary ==
The Star Wars CCG World Championship page of the [[DecipherCon 1999 website]], as archived on 28 November 1999. Screenshot of the Internet Archive's copy, rendered in a desktop browser at 800 pixels wide. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].

== Source ==
* [http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/index.html Star Wars CCG World Championship], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128144348/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/index.html Internet Archive]
* Rendered with headless Chrome (Playwright) on 27 October 2026 from the archived HTML and the archived images. Site-wide decipher.com icons that the Wayback Machine did not save are left blank.
* Page content: Decipher.
